extraction.notes: Three-month 2023 column of Attachment 2 (page printed 3). The NAREIT FFO subtotal is presented on a basic basis ($217,709); the Series E preferred distribution add-back ($1,222) is included in ffo_adjustments as 'other' so that ffo_total equals the diluted FFO of $218,931 used for the reported $0.61 per-share figure. Basic subtotal is therefore not a separate field. Variable upside participation on DCP shows '$-' for Q4 2023 and is recorded as 0. Checks: 218,931/356,252 = 0.61; 223,762/356,252 = 0.63; 193,629/356,252 = 0.54. Net (gain)/loss on consolidation categorized as nareit_other. Starting line and totals reconcile exactly to printed values.
